sources.title: Data Center Group reports construction start of nexspace Graz extension
sources.summary: The original planner and builder report states that nexspace started construction of the extension to its Graz data centre with the August 26 groundbreaking. DCG completed the design and now undertakes construction of the four-storey extension. This supports the construction start of one extension within the existing commercial campus, not completion, operating expansion capacity or a second site.
sources.date_semantics: Visible original article date is August 26, 2026; its body expressly dates construction start to August 26. September 3 syndication is not the event date. Conflicting September/end-of-2027 completion targets are forecasts only.

sources.title: Liquid Web reports DC3 Lansing physical power-supply repair and restored servers
sources.summary: The original public incident API contains incident gf3w6x9h9hmg, Lansing DC Rack Outage. Its September 23 monitoring update explicitly reports that the Data Center Operations team replaced the PSU and affected servers are back online and operating normally. The affected component is Data Centers - DC3 - LAN. A later same-day resolved update confirms restored server operation. This is a specific physical repair and operating-server observation at the named commercial host, not a generic dashboard health flag. No new opening, capacity, building ownership or uptime guarantee is inferred.
sources.date_semantics: Selected incident updates have original created_at, updated_at and display_at timestamps 2026-09-23T10:39:47.238-04:00 (physical PSU replacement and restored servers) and 2026-09-23T13:38:55.652-04:00 (resolved). September 23 is the dated report of this achieved physical work and current operation. Retrieval and the current component status are not observation dates.

sources.title: Liquid Web original RSS preserves DC3 repair, completed maintenance and later scheduled work
sources.summary: The original RSS independently preserves the September 23 rack incident. That future work is not treated as achieved. The selected operation observation remains the explicit September 23 physical repair and restored servers.
